code.text: Post-treatment summary — to the referring pediatric practice

problem.display: Dental caries penetrating into the pulp, tooth #4

summary: Joe Castle seen 2026-07-22 per referral from Dr. Mary Parker. Pulpal caries (K02.53) and periapical infection (K04.7) confirmed on tooth #4. Guardian consent obtained. Root canal therapy (D3320), core build-up (D2950), and crown (D2740) completed without complication. Post-operative radiograph shows adequate obturation and crown seating. Healing status: no complications at completion.

note.text: Recommendations: 1. Routine follow-up at the pediatric practice at next recall; 2. Monitor for post-restorative sensitivity; 3. Continue routine pediatric preventive care. The summary text is the UC07 narrative's, verbatim. 'Guardian consent obtained' is narrative text only: the Consent resource belongs to the deferred interaction 3 and is not in this data set.
